items.statement: The Jacobian is not supplied to the pure trace map; Part A derives finitely many candidates.
The conclusion is quasi-finiteness, not injectivity, global uniqueness, generic degree one, or exact fiber cardinality.
No exact map degree, generic degree, or branch divisor is claimed.
The global theorem covers only the normalized single-factor H^1_4 and its finite residual quotient, not compositions, arbitrary loxodromic automorphisms, unnormalized spaces, or multifactored moduli.
Part A is over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field; Parts B and C remain only over C.
Formal-period zero-cycles with scheme-theoretic multiplicity are essential; reduced periodic points cannot replace them.
Cantat--Dujardin's general rigidity, unspecified cutoff, exceptional family, and lower-period blindness are not new here.
No novelty is claimed for classical residues, formal dynatomic methods, Friedland--Milnor normal forms, Sugiyama, Huguin, or fixed-point identities.
The absorbed Paper 12 exceptional-curve classification, formal subtraction, coefficient ledgers, and period-three moment receive no renewed novelty credit.
No P(d)=3 all-degree theorem, effective universal cutoff, or universal coefficient nonvanishing is claimed.
The period-three second power sum separates only the already isolated exceptional curve E and is not a global classifier of H^1_4.
No code, computation, CAS run, parameter scan, experiment, or numerical check is theorem evidence.
No absolute priority, first-result, newly discovered exceptional-family, or absence-of-unpublished-work claim is authorized.

items: Derive the fixed algebra and pure fixed-trace characteristic polynomial.
Prove C_f'(s)=0 in squarefree and nonreduced cases without illicit division.
Enumerate Jacobians before the fixed-Jacobian Cantat--Dujardin theorem.
Derive the length-16 period-two tensor algebra and formal length-12 subtraction on a=1.
Close all five quartic root partitions, using Sugiyama only on [1111].
Prove [22] union [4] is exactly E and exclude unseen a not equal to 1 components.
Establish the rank-64 period-three complete-intersection and Tr(M_(t^2))=Res(t^3).
Prove two-term support, two agreeing slope certificates, and the exact constant ledger.
Prove fixed-algebra nilpotence, local lengths 2 and 4, pointwise length 60, and delayed division by 3.
Separate global fibers, use the moment only on E, then apply finite type and the direct finite-quotient argument.

safe_title: Low-Period Trace Fibers of Quartic Generalized Hénon Maps

part_A.base_field: Any algebraically closed field k of characteristic zero.
part_A.candidate_bound: A prescribed formal fixed trace multiset leaves at most d-1 Jacobians and at most 3 in degree four.
part_A.purity: The Jacobian is derived as a finite output candidate and is never supplied to the trace map.

part_B.exact_non_quasi_finite_locus: E={(a,p):a=1 and p(x)=(x^2-L)^2 for L in C}
part_B.lower_trace_fiber: Trace_1=0 with multiplicity 4 and Trace_2=2 with multiplicity 12.
part_B.quotient: E/mu_3 is A^1 with coordinate L^3.

part_C.cutoff: P_(H^1)(4)=3 for formal pure trace data on the normalized single-factor quartic space.
part_C.global_statement: T_<=3 is quasi-finite on H^1_4 and M^1_4, while T_<=2 is not quasi-finite on either.
part_C.separator_scope: Equality of full Trace_3 multisets implies equality of this moment only after the lower fiber has been identified as E.
